$comment: Reasoning repair contract (2026-04-11): reasoning overlays, when present, remain advisory and presentation-only under CONTROL selection and SECURITY validation.
title: AMIP v0.1 Payload Schema
description: Deterministic JSON Schema for the SARA Gen1 AMIP v0.1 local payload contract, aligned to the Stage-4 specsheet.

mode.description: Local execution mode resolved for the request.

routing_intent.description: Deterministic routing intent consumed by CONTROL and the Bucey Shunt FSM.

payload.description: Action-specific AMIP request payload. Reasoning overlays, if included, must remain nested advisory data and must not mutate routing headers or trust authority.

uuid_string.description: UUID string used for cross-request and workflow correlation.

strain.description: Relative local strain level requested for the interaction.

tokens.description: Deterministic token or work-unit budget for the interaction.

runtime_ms.description: Maximum permitted runtime in milliseconds for the local request.

profile_id.description: Identifier of the CORE-owned machine profile bound to the AMIP request.

profile_version.description: Optional version of the referenced machine profile.
